title: Brighter + Shader Chaos Cubed Panorama 26.2
description: The panorama of the "Chaos Cubed" drop in Minecraft 26.2, but NATURALLY brighter. Even with a version that includes shaders!
body:
## About

It simply does what its title says. It is a hand-made recreation of the original panorama of this drop, "Chaos Cubed" with better lighting, made using light blocks and simulated using lichens, in order to maintain the consistency of the natural generation of Minecraft panoramas, instead of using torches or another way to illuminate the space, which is artificial. All this, with the aim of having a better title screen without a boring and totally dark background.
